column2: [intro]
Tired of the daily grind, everything’s so gray,
Need a splash of whimsy, a touch of play.
I’m diving in, no turning back,
Towards a future that's full of slack.
I crave a change, a fresh new view,
To explore new paradises, bright and true.
A new chapter, that’s what I need,
Throwing my worries to the sea!
I want to see the world in technicolor,
Laugh for no reason, lose all sense of order.
Goodbye worries, hello freedom’s embrace,
Escaping the monotony at a brisk pace.
I’ll dance through my troubles,
Party on, forgetting the struggles.
A new start, that’s what I want,
Living life completely, with no taunt.
[ solo ]
I’ll be the Master of laughter,
On stage, shining bright, breaking free after.
With my voice, I'll make it sing,
The whole world, in joy, I'll bring.
[outro]
